name: mirage
text: The engine's bid desk is stopping itself on purpose: the picked-off guard. Right now its status says 'picked off: 4 of the last 8 fills were picked off (the fair had already moved under the price), average EV at the fill +0.8% against +2.5% when posted'. When that happens the desk takes all 47 resting bids down and halts for 3 hours, to stop it from feeding sharper traders. So the stops are the guard firing, not a crash. Whether it fires too easily (4 of 8 is a small sample) is a tuning question; I'll look at its history and loosen it only if the data supports that, since it protects real money. Separately, the Kalshi bids lane is running fine.
